item.title: [IGNITE-7212] Load stoped after server node kill
item.description:

  • Start 4 servers
  • Start load tasks on 5 clients
  • Kill 1 server
  • Waiting for rebalancing

item.summary: Load stoped after server node kill

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
The issue is related to org/apache/ignite/spi/communication/tcp/TcpCommunicationSpi.java:3110
We loop forever here. This is a regression introduced by IGNITE-6639.
